messages.subject: error irace
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I am a student from University of Udine, and I have to show a presentation about irac
I'm trying to execute the example about simulated Annealing Algorithms (SANN) (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/irace/irace.pdf) but there is a problem:
when I compile irace this error appear:

Error: == irace == The output of targetRunner must be a list
== irace == The output was:

== irace == This is not a bug in irace, but means that something failed in a call to the targetRunner or targetEvaluator functions provided by the user. Please check those functions carefully.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-wRyR2-mjuj8/WHEhi1O3WBI/AAAAAAAAA7Q/P0ft5y1NIswDles6AAJkzzYGx9S2d76HgCLcB/s1600/targetrunner.PNG>
 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-tL5ufphTo_A/WHEh_16MuyI/AAAAAAAAA7U/svt3mtpq2xwNU6jdZMDc-HKu9QJLwFXlQCLcB/s1600/result.PNG>

How can I solve it?
Thanks,
Marco

messages.subject: Re: error irace
messages.body_plain:
Hello Marco,

We have changed the version of irace, and the output of the target runner function must be now a list containing the elements "cost" and "time" (time only when needed).

For the SA example you just have to return the list:

target.runner <- function(experiment, scenario) {
  instance <- experiment$instance
  configuration <- experiment$configuration
  D <- 3
  par <- runif(D, min=-1, max=1)
  fn <- function(x) {
    weight <- instance
    return(weight * f_rastrigin(x) + (1 - weight) * f_rosenbrock(x))
  }
  res <- optim(par,fn, method="SANN", control=list(maxit=5000 , tmax = as.numeric(configuration[["tmax"]]), temp = as.numeric(configuration[["temp"]])))

  result <- list(cost=res$value)
  return(result)
}

I hope this solves your problems, let us know if you have any other issue!
Good luck with the presentation!

Leslie.
